info.description:
new-api 控制台和管理后台使用的接口，路径都在 /api 下。

响应：除另有说明外，响应体是 common.ApiResponse：success 表示是否成功，message 是提示文本，data 是数据。业务失败通常仍返回 HTTP 200，success 为 false；鉴权失败返回 401 或 403，并带 code（如 AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED）。

鉴权：Authorization: Bearer <访问令牌>。访问令牌是登录得到的 15 分钟 JWT（用 POST /api/user/auth/refresh 凭登录时返回的 refresh_token 续期，每次续期都换发新的 refresh_token），或在安全设置里创建的个人访问令牌（PAT）。UserAuth、AdminAuth、RootAuth 是同一个请求头，区别在要求的角色。删除账户、绑定账号等敏感操作还要带 X-Security-Proof，先用 POST /api/verify 完成二次验证取得。

跨域：前后端分开部署时，/api 和 /pg 只对环境变量 FRONTEND_ORIGINS 和系统设置「前端地址」里的来源返回 CORS 头，不带凭证；/api/usage/token 和 /api/log/token 与 AI 接口一样允许任意来源。

LegacyAudioClips are the audio clips of a successful pre-plugin Suno
task, listed for the web console only.

legacy_content_url.description: LegacyContentURL is the video of a successful pre-plugin video task.

icon.description:
Icon carries the sidecar icon.svg / icon.png as a data URI. It is optional
and stored separately from the source so the JavaScript stays readable.

allow_user_quota_query.description: 指针区分“未传”和显式 false：新建时未传即开启，更新时未传则保留原值。

cross_group_retry.description: 跨分组重试，仅auto分组有效

allow_user_quota_query.description: 允许用此令牌查询所属用户的额度；新建令牌默认开启，已有令牌升级后保持关闭

cross_group_retry.description: 跨分组重试，仅auto分组有效

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt is 0 when the token never expires.

user_quota.description:
UserQuota is present only when the token allows querying its owner's
quota.

backup_codes_remaining.description:
BackupCodesRemaining is present while two-factor authentication is
enabled and the unused backup codes could be counted.

ratio.description:
Ratio is the group ratio for the user's group, or "auto" for the auto
group.

sidebar_modules.description: SidebarModules marks the sidebar areas the role cannot use.

live.description: Live is the newest stored live rate, nil when none was fetched.

override.description:
Override is the pinned rate of one Base in Quote, empty when there is
none.

status.description:
Status is the state of the live rate: RateStatusLive, RateStatusStale
or RateStatusMissing.

uses.description:
Uses are what the site converts with the pair; empty for an override
nothing uses any more.

result_discarded.description:
ResultDiscarded marks a synchronous result that was returned inline and
never persisted; the UI must not offer artifact retrieval for it.

result_url.description: 任务结果 URL（视频地址等）

payment_amount.description:
An empty PaymentCurrency means the checkout of the invoice has not
started. ExchangeRate converted the order's amount into it.

trade_no.description:
TradeNo is the gateway payment bound to the invoice; one payment binds
at most one invoice of its platform.

fee_mode.description:
The fee is FeeRateBp basis points of the price and/or FeeFixed
hundredths of the site currency, as FeeMode selects.

currency.description:
Currency is the site currency the price is in. Amount = Price +
Adjustment + FeeAmount, where Adjustment is what the group ratio and
the amount discount change (negative for a discount).

payment_method_id.description:
The payment method, the payment expectation and the trade show the
order's latest invoice, and once the order is paid the invoice that
paid it (a manual completion's trade is ManualTradeNo). They are a copy
for lists and statistics; checkouts, callbacks and settlement read the
invoices. A balance order names the balance method itself.

payment_option_id.description: PaymentOptionId is the payment option the buyer chose.

topup_amount.description:
TopupAmount is the face value bought, in the site currency. QuotaAmount
is the quota a top-up credits or a balance purchase deducts, converted
at QuotaRate, the site currency to USD rate when the order was made.

invoice_no.description:
InvoiceNo is the invoice the payment was made for; empty for a manual
completion.

label.description:
Label and Description are English source text the frontend
translates.

managed.description: Managed fields are maintained by the server and not edited.

options.description: Options are the values a FieldSelect field takes, in display order.

secret.description: Secret fields are never returned to the browser.

type.description: Type is FieldSelect, FieldTextarea or empty for a text field.

when.description:
When limits the field to configurations whose fields hold these
values; the configuration drops it otherwise.

label.description: Label is English source text the frontend translates.

payment_method_type.description:
PaymentMethodType is the one Stripe payment method type the intent
collects (card, alipay or wechat_pay); it selects the client's flow.

languages.description:
Languages are the backend languages; DefaultLanguage is the one a
reader who states none gets.

test_kinds.description: TestKinds are the emails a test can send.

amount_discount.description:
AmountDiscount maps such an amount to the multiplier its price is
charged at.

amount_options.description: AmountOptions are top-up amounts in whole units of the site currency.

min_topup.description: MinTopup is the smallest top-up, a decimal amount of the site currency.

currencies.description: Currencies are the currencies a site may price in.

kind.description: Kind is one of the test kinds ListEmailTemplates returns.

provider.description: Provider is the sending method to test: smtp, resend or cloudflare.

models.description:
Models restricts this route to the listed models. The host matches the
canonical top-level "model" body field before any JS hook runs; empty
means unrestricted. Must be a subset of meta.models.

retainResult.description:
RetainResult, when explicitly false on a submit or dynamic route, tells
the host not to persist the upstream snapshot of an immediate terminal
result and to treat the task as not found on every retrieval surface
afterwards. nil means the route did not declare it (retain).

required.description: Required are the variables the body must use.

variables.description: Vars are the variables the sender fills; SystemName is always there.

actor_role.description: Immutable role of the actor when the event began, not the log owner.

settings.description: 其他设置，存储azure版本等不需要检索的信息，详见dto.ChannelOtherSettings

multi_key_disabled_reason.description: key禁用原因列表，key index -> reason

multi_key_disabled_time.description: key禁用时间列表，key index -> time

position.description: before / after use descending priority order

expired_time.description: 过期时间，0 表示不过期

allow_wallet_overflow.description: Allow falling back to wallet balance after subscription quota is exhausted (empty = true)

downgrade_group.description: Downgrade user group on expiry (empty = revert to the group held before purchase)

total_amount.description: Total quota (amount in quota units, 0 = unlimited)

upgrade_group.description: Upgrade user group after purchase (empty = no change)

original_password.description: this field is only for Password change verification, don't save it to database!

verification_code.description: this field is only for Email verification, don't save it to database!

allow_wallet_overflow.description: Whether wallet fallback is allowed after this subscription's quota is exhausted (snapshot from plan)

downgrade_group.description: Downgrade target group on expiry (snapshot from plan; empty = revert to PrevUserGroup)

payment_amount.description:
PaymentAmount and PaymentCurrency are what the buyer is charged, once
a checkout started.

payment_option.description:
PaymentOption names the payment option; Balance marks an order the
wallet balance pays.

failures.description:
Failures counts the checkouts that failed in a row and count towards
the breaker; a refusal, for one, does not.

last_error.description:
LastError and LastFailedAt describe the latest failed checkout,
counted or not.

tripped_until.description:
TrippedUntil ends the channel's cooldown, in Unix seconds; 0 when it
was not tripped.

domain.description:
Domain is the base URL gateway callbacks are sent to; empty selects
the site address.

health.description:
Health is what this server saw of the channel's checkouts since the
last one that started; nil when none failed.

min_amount.description:
The method takes orders whose price, in hundredths of the site
currency, is at least MinAmount and at most MaxAmount; 0 leaves that
end open.

notify_url.description:
NotifyURL is the callback URL gateways are given; empty for the
balance or when no public address is configured.

option_id.description: OptionId is the payment option the method collects.

priority.description:
Priority orders the methods of an option: the lowest priority that
has a method able to take an order is tried first, and its methods
share the orders by Weight.

webhook_stale.description:
WebhookStale reports a Stripe method whose registered webhook does not
point at NotifyURL; syncing the webhook fixes it.

fee_mode.description:
The fee is FeeRateBp basis points of the price and/or FeeFixed
hundredths of the site currency, as FeeMode selects.

unavailable.description: Unavailable says why the option cannot take an order now.

amount.description:
Amount is the top-up amount in the site currency, with at most two
decimal places.

adjustment.description:
Adjustment is what the top-up group ratio and the amount discount
change; negative for a discount.

quota_amount.description:
QuotaAmount is the quota a top-up credits or a balance purchase
deducts, converted at QuotaRate (site currency to USD).

recent_success_series.description:
RecentSuccessSeries contains up to 24 nonempty hours from the last 7 days,
including requested models with no traffic in the summary window.
